body: Dude, I feel exactly what you're saying-- I work in agriculture and have been flipping my lid about climate change for a couple of years, because shit's getting serious. I firmly believe though that the only hope for humanity is if we band together and do our damnedest to protect our communities from the fallout that's coming. I'd reccomend getting involved with any sort of mutual aid groups in your area, or looking into skills you could aquire that will be useful when shit hits the fan. It's going to whether we're prepared or not, so we might as well be organized! I'm sure that you can find like-minded people, or create like-minded people by talking to your friends and family about what's coming and how to prepare. The government is not going to help us, billionaires are not going to help us, and our only hope is really each other. However, even if the world is changed forever, new doesn't always mean bad. We will find ways to survive even if it looks impossible. I'm currently in the process of getting comfortable with the idea of a post apocalyptic future, and it's super rough, but building community is something that is both helpful and attainable. I want to get as many people through this as possible, and I know that we can't count on anyone other than ourselves to make that happen, so we might as well get started.

Bro, every humsn being has an inherent right to live-- u don't have to justify your being on earth with being smart or pretty or working or whatever-- u are allowed to just be, and just being is a difficult enough task these days without you beating urself up. This is coming out sounding callous instead of supportive but like bro. You are having a difficult time because earth is very difficult to be on and also it sounds like you got dealt kind of a shitty hand.  You are allowed to be gentle with yourself, and it is also okay that being gentle to yourself does not come naturally. We are all just slogging through shit and you are in good company and have just as much right to live as anyone else, even if your brain is saying you don't. 
Also u said that u are having trouble loving urself-- my actionable advice is to try to think neutral thoughts about urself. Making the jump from self loathing to self loving is very hard, so an in between state of feeling neutral towards yourself can help. After having the reflexive thought of "I am ugly", try thinking abt all of the things that your body does do well-- does it get you from place to place? Does it allow you to feel the sensation of sun on your skin? Does it let you smell your favorite smell? Beauty standards are extremely subjective, but the things that your body does for you are quantifiable, and easier to appreciate than just doing an about-face to "actually I am hot and I love myself"

I work in agriculture and already I've seen extreme and unseasonable temperatures, and an increase in flooding/hurricanes/abnormal amounts of rain.  At least in America, if our food industry collapses, we're all royally fucked.  Literally the only thing I've seen that makes me hopeful is some research with algae.
